source_audit.native_g38_provenance: EDC v3.1 GradeLevel codebook labels G38 as SEA-sourced aggregate grades 3–8. Use exact published ProficientOrAbove_percent only; EDC may sum achievement-level percentages within this native total. No grade aggregation is performed.
source_audit.tested_denominator: Unverified; retained raw but excluded from every model and interval.

state_lunch_notes.Error Message: The total Direct Certification was greater than the count of students reported as Free Lunch Qualified.
state_lunch_notes.State Note: This data originates from school districts, it is accurate as presented. However, some districts misidentified Direct Certification student as R-Reduced rather than F-Free. Moving forward, the Nevada Department of Education will enhance its review of district-submitted data to promptly detect and rectify such errors before EDFacts data submissions

source_audit.approval_basis: SEA-native G38 grade total documented in EDC v3.1 codebook; exact published rate, one regular assessment/threshold, same-year reported individual-school CCD DC and membership, audited grade scope and state notes.
